name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 11 · déplier, gaspiller, froisser
note: Tiered verb place; all six verbs are -er, so all live on the LEFT cottages (the right side is an orchard with no verbs). Street: girl sweet-talking the grumpy cat flat, fox cheating at cards under a little potted tree, cobbler shoeing a pony; balcony: man gasping at the hose he left running; upper window: boy unfolding a huge map; roof terrace: boy crumpling paper beside a frowning frog. Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
